description: Converts USD to INR using the live exchange rate stored in TARA_USD_INR_RATE environment variable. If not set, returns an error — no hardcoded rates.
notes: Previously contained a hardcoded rate (86.5 INR/USD) as a Python script.
Hardcoded rates are prohibited — they become stale and mislead users.
The actual conversion logic must read TARA_USD_INR_RATE at runtime or call a live rate API.
This JSON stub is a placeholder until a live rate feed is wired into the data skill domain.
